source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

original_test_intent: Verify that approved RAM Disk Configuration values persist across save/reboot and return to SPEC defaults after Load Default without unexpectedly consuming usable memory, losing owned volatile content, or breaking boot/recovery behavior.
original_method: Change RAM Disk fields in BIOS, save/reboot and verify persistence; then Load Default, save/reboot and compare with SPEC while collecting firmware, memory-allocation, RAM-disk, boot/recovery and health evidence.
manual_activity: A human must navigate RAM Disk Configuration, perform both save/reboot/default phases and inspect firmware values. Automated memory/RAM-disk inventory only supports the core manual acceptance.
required_inputs: Named RAM Disk fields with baseline, safe non-default and SPEC-default values
RAM-disk ownership, content, volatility and boot/recovery role
Total/usable/reserved memory baseline and workload limits
Console/operator, content backup/disposable policy, stable power and BMC/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random or assume RAM-disk content survives reboot/configuration changes.
Back up authorized content or prove it is disposable before any change.
Do not reduce usable memory below the approved workload/OS minimum.
Stop on missing recovery artifact, unexpected content loss, memory shortfall, hang, boot or management loss.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only total/usable/reserved memory, RAM-disk/mount, boot/recovery and BMC/OS health evidence.
Compare firmware captures and approved non-secret content metadata against the matrix.
Do not drive BIOS, copy unapproved data, mount/write RAM disks or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Define/approve fields/defaults, content ownership/disposition, memory limits and recovery.
Evaluate firmware, allocation and recovery-path evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent BIOS execution. No source command exists; OS memory/RAM-disk inventory is read-only supporting evidence and cannot prove firmware control behavior.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain manual BIOS changes and use approved read-only memory, RAM-disk, mount and boot inventory; do not create/mount/write an OS RAM disk as a substitute.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source two-phase sequence, no-script state and 5/20-minute fields are preserved; all/random remains source wording but is bounded out of execution.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each approved firmware field to reserved/usable memory, RAM-disk identity, content lifetime and boot/recovery role; capture firmware and read-only allocation/artifact evidence at baseline, persistence, default restoration and final state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BIOS RAM-disk implementation and installed OS/recovery workflow.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, OS/kernel and inventory-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform RAM Disk Configuration specification and project recovery/content-retention policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds volatile-content ownership and memory-limit controls while retaining both firmware transitions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; no persistent-data or write-path claim is made unless separately approved.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Field/default matrix, content owner/lifetime and usable-memory limits.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS-visible memory and RAM-disk behavior may differ from firmware allocation semantics; both views must be identified rather than conflated.

project_override_considerations: The project may choose a disposable test artifact and approved RAM size. Completion applies to that configuration and must not claim persistence of volatile data or all allocation sizes.
expected_evidence: Identity, approval, memory/RAM-disk/content baseline and recovery
First save/reboot persistence plus memory/RAM-disk/boot evidence
Load Default, second save/reboot, SPEC comparison and recovery health
Final allocation/state, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require persistence and SPEC-default restoration. Missing ownership and memory-allocation details are readiness inputs rather than contradictions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The RAM-disk lifecycle is clear. Content, limits and recovery gate execution but do not permanently block the generic library case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with its manual boundary and adds content-lifetime/allocation safety.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its useful RAM-disk evidence and recovery controls but rejects PARTIAL based solely on supporting automation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Restores MANUAL ONLY and separates firmware RAM disk from an OS-created substitute.

review_improvement: Prevents silent loss of volatile recovery artifacts and avoids using an unrelated OS RAM disk as proof of firmware behavior.
independent_technical_reasoning: Human firmware actions and visual state checks are decisive, so MANUAL ONLY applies. Read-only memory evidence cannot automate the firmware acceptance.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat RAM allocation changes, reboot or default load after content, memory or boot anomalies; preserve the first evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
